cmsy_compare(): 比较多次CMSY++运行结果，或与其他评估比较

Source: vignettes/articles/zh/reference/cmsy_compare.Rmd
cmsy_compare.Rmd

英文原页：cmsy_compare()

说明

本函数绘制多次cmsy_run()运行（例如采用不同起始年份或先验的敏感性分析）中同一批种群的B/Bmsy和F/Fmsy，也可以加入其他评估的结果，并给出它们最后一年数值的表格。

English

This function draws B/Bmsy and F/Fmsy of the same stocks from several runs of cmsy_run() (e.g. with different start years or priors, a sensitivity analysis) and, optionally, from other assessments, and gives a table of their last-year values.

用法 

cmsy_compare(
  ...,
  stocks = NULL,
  external = NULL,
  lang = NULL,
  annotations = getOption("faofishingreport.cmsy_annotations", FALSE),
  pptx = getOption("faofishingreport.pptx", FALSE),
  silent = fao_setting("silent")
)

参数

...
cmsy_run()的结果，可以命名，也可以不命名（例如default = run1, start_1980 = run2）。
English Results of cmsy_run(), named or not (e.g. default = run1, start_1980 = run2).
stocks
要比较的种群（可选）：Stock标识，或物种的FAO英文或中文名称、学名或FAO三字母代码。默认为NULL，即所有已运行的种群。
English Optional stocks to compare: Stock identifiers or species, by English or Chinese FAO name, scientific name or FAO 3-alpha code. Default is NULL, all stocks that ran.
external
其他估计结果的数据框（可选），包含Stock、Year、B_Bmsy（可选F_Fmsy）和source列（source为图例中显示的名称，例如另一项评估的机构或模型）。
English Optional data frame of other estimates, with columns Stock, Year, B_Bmsy (and optionally F_Fmsy) and source (the name shown in the legend, e.g. the agency or model of the other assessment).
lang
图表文字和名称的语言：“en”（英文）、“zh”（中文）或”both”（中英双语）。默认为NULL，即使用fao_settings()设置的语言（未更改时为”en”）。
English The language of the chart text and names: “en” (English), “zh” (Chinese) or “both” (Chinese and English). Default is NULL, which uses the language set with fao_settings() (“en” unless changed).
annotations
在坐标轴标题和坐标轴标签之外添加的文字：FALSE（默认）不添加，TRUE全部添加，或”title”、“subtitle”、“caption”、“legend”和”labels”（图内文字）中的任意几项。可以用options(faofishingreport.cmsy_annotations = TRUE)更改本次R会话的默认值。
English The text added to the axis titles and labels: FALSE (default) none, TRUE all, or any of “title”, “subtitle”, “caption”, “legend” and “labels” (text inside the chart). The default can be changed for the session with options(faofishingreport.cmsy_annotations = TRUE).
pptx
逻辑值。为TRUE时，图表还另存为可编辑的PowerPoint文件，保存在figures/pptx/cmsy/compare/。默认为FALSE，可以用fao_settings(pptx = TRUE)为所有函数统一更改。
English A logical value. If TRUE, the charts are also saved as editable PowerPoint files in figures/pptx/cmsy/compare/. Default is FALSE, which can be changed for all functions with fao_settings(pptx = TRUE).
silent
逻辑值。为TRUE时不输出种群匹配情况的提示信息。默认为FALSE，或fao_settings(silent = )设置的值。
English A logical value. If TRUE, the messages on how the stocks were matched are not printed. Default is FALSE, or the value set with fao_settings(silent = ).

返回值

以不可见方式返回一个列表，包含last_year（每个种群和每次运行一行）和plots。

English

Invisibly, a list with last_year (one row per stock and run) and plots.

示例 

# Sensitivity to the start year
run_1950 <- cmsy_run(input, stocks = "GRB_34", seed = 1)
run_auto <- cmsy_run(input, stocks = "GRB_34", seed = 1, auto_start = TRUE)
cmsy_compare(`from 1950` = run_1950, `CMSY++ start year` = run_auto, annotations = "legend")

# Sensitivity to a CMSY++ setting (see cmsy_defaults())
run_cv <- cmsy_run(input, stocks = "GRB_34", seed = 1, auto_start = TRUE, settings = list(CV.C = 0.3))
cmsy_compare(default = run_auto, `CV.C = 0.3` = run_cv)$last_year

# With another assessment of the same stock, read from a file with the columns
# Stock, Year, B_Bmsy (optionally F_Fmsy) and source
other <- read.csv("other_assessment.csv")
cmsy_compare(CMSY = run_auto, external = other, annotations = "legend")
